title: AO/273/2013 of Smt Sheetal Goyal AND OTHERS Vs Anjinesh Kumar Gautam AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
AO No. 273 of 2013
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Non
None is present for the appellants.
The learned counsel of the
appellants was permitted to take steps to
serve respondent no. 2 by the order dated
11.3.2014. Thereafter, appeal was listed
on 30.5.2014 and again the learned
counsel of the appellants was permitted
to serve respondent no. 2 by registered
post AD in addition to normal mode of
service within a week.
Pursuant to the order dated
30.5.2014 no steps have been taken. It
appears that appellant is not interested in
pursuing this appeal.
The same is dismissed in non-prosecution.
